subject: Proposal: Combine Runtime + Serving into Inference Platform — review & HR next steps
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@peopleops.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Combine Runtime + Serving into Inference Platform — review & HR next steps

Team —

After the last two ops reviews and the cost/latency analysis, Im putting forward a proposal to merge Inference Runtime and Model Serving into a single "Inference Platform" org. The goals are to:
- Reduce duplicated infra ownership (routing, batching, cache layers)
- Improve operational SLAs by consolidating on a single runtime roadmap
- Provide clearer career paths for engineers working across inference stack layers

High level changes in the attached org_chart_v1.pdf:
- New group: Inference Platform, led by a single Group Manager (proposed: Marcus Lin as interim lead)
- Two pods under the group: Serving (model deployment, kernel selection) and Runtime (batching, KV cache, autoscaling)
- Reporting line changes: a small set (~3) of senior ICs would shift managers; two manager roles may be consolidated across the current teams

This is sensitive from a people/process perspective — it will intersect with annual performance reviews and potential scope reductions in a couple of manager-level roles. Ive attached a conservative headcount_impact.xlsx and a draft comms plan (comm_plan_draft.docx).

Immediate asks:
1) Read the attachments and flag any factual errors by EOD Monday.
2) Aditya: can you confirm the projected savings and what we can and cannot convert into reallocated headcount?
3) Evelyn: draft a short comms outline for the teams and a timeline for review calibration so we avoid surprises during performance cycles.
4) Laura/PeopleOps: we will need a private list of impacted roles and a protected review process — see sensitive_candidates.csv stub.

Id like to run a 30-minute sync next Wednesday (calendar placeholder in related_links) to agree on the timeline and finalize who will be informed in the first wave. If this broadly looks reasonable, Ill route a formal proposal to execs next week.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org_chart_v1.pdf (org chart), headcount_impact.xlsx (impact scenarios), comm_plan_draft.docx (comms draft)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Combine Runtime + Serving into Inference Platform — review & HR next steps

+1 on consolidation direction; I think the technical overlap has been a problem for a while. A couple of quick asks/notes:
- Can we get a clear delta on headcount vs. cost savings? Im specifically interested in 12/24 month TCO and how much we would actually free up for hires elsewhere.
- If manager roles are consolidated, whats our target for re-banding vs. voluntary moves? We need to be deliberate to avoid retroactive calibration issues during reviews.
- We should coordinate with Finance on severance budgeting early.

I can take the TCO numbers by Monday if you want me to own that.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP, Serving & Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — this is a good direction. A few tactical suggestions:
- Comms: two-stage approach. First: leaders-only briefing + Q&A. Second (48h later): team-level AMA + written FAQ. Keep role-impact messaging high-level in the first wave.
- Reviews: set a calibration window before public comms. PeopleOps should prepare guidance to managers for mid-cycle changes — do not finalize performance-related moves until calibration is complete.
- Timeline: recommend a 6-week operational transition for systems + a 12-week people transition window for reassignments and backfills. That preserves review cycles.

Ill draft the comms outline and an FAQ skeleton this afternoon and upload to the Confluence page (link in related_links). Marcus — can you confirm interim leads and any cross-functional dependencies?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference
